description: This file defines API routes related to video management in a FastAPI application, including listing videos, retrieving details, uploading, and streaming videos. It interacts with database models, handles file uploads, and uses external services for storage and validation.

methods.name: list_videos( session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session), q: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Optional search string to filter by title"), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list available videos, optionally filtered by a search query.

methods.name: get_video( video_id: int = FPath(..., description="ID of the video"), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve detailed information about a specific video, including associated subtitles.

methods.name: upload_video( title: str = Query(..., description="Title for the uploaded video"), description: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Optional description"), file: UploadFile = File(..., description="Binary video file to upload"), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session), )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to upload a new video file, save it to disk, and create a database record.

methods.name: stream_video( video_id: int = FPath(..., description="ID of the video to stream"), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to stream the binary contents of a specified video file.

ctags.name: FPath
ctags.pattern: /^from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, File, HTTPException, Path as FPath, Query, UploadFile$/

ctags.name: get_video
ctags.signature: ( video_id: int = FPath(..., description="ID of the video"), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session), )

ctags.name: list_videos
ctags.signature: ( session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session), q: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Optional search string to filter by title"), )

ctags.name: stream_video
ctags.signature: ( video_id: int = FPath(..., description="ID of the video to stream"), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session), )
